algorithm.allocator_cache_policy: retain through a whole E; empty only at E boundary/finally
algorithm.checkpoint_policy: normal writes at configured completed-batch/time intervals and E/final completion; unexpected exit preserves only the last durable contiguous prefix
algorithm.endpoint_normalization: endpoints explicitly set to 1; padded tails excluded
algorithm.hot_path: prepacked MPS option tables plus vectorized index_select gathers; metrics/top64 copied to CPU

claim_boundary: MPS double-single ranks finite numerical candidates; it is not a proof of acceptance or exclusion.

balanced_enumeration.for_E_1_to_Lminus1: select E lift groups in every block; no original group
balanced_enumeration.for_E_L: each block chooses original group or all L lift groups; fix block 0 to original
